title: Nav rail size must come from navRailSize metrics, not fixed constants
answers: How do I change nav rail width or icon size?
Add a new nav rail item or setting
body:
Rail dimensions come from one table in features/sidebar/navRailSize.ts via `useNavRailMetrics()` (width, iconSize, gapClassName); `NAV_RAIL_WIDTH` was removed.
- Anything sized against the rail must use the hook: NavRail.tsx, ChannelsSidebar.tsx (edge-hover peek `offset`), ChannelsFab.tsx (rail icon size).
- The size is the `navRailSize` (small/medium/large) in `useSettingsStore`, set on the Appearance page (AppearanceSettings.tsx).
- Rail items render via shared `NavRailTile`; destinations use optional `shortLabel` for the caption and `placement: "more"` (railDestinations.ts) to file under the More hover item, which reports `in_more: true` in `pick`.
- New settings pages need entries in SETTINGS_PAGES (SettingsPageContent.tsx) and sidebar groups (SettingsPanel.tsx).
applies: desktop channels-layout nav rail and settings Appearance page
